nodes.label: ss2vr.ini
nodes.rationale: Configuration file for the VR mod; supports hot-reloading via F7.

nodes.label: ss2vr_move.nut
nodes.rationale: Squirrel script for native movement action bridge.

nodes.label: ss2vr_effects.nut
nodes.rationale: Squirrel script for game-event triggered visual effects (damage/hazard).

nodes.label: Parachute Backup
nodes.rationale: A parachute backup of the pre-controller code/build was saved at D:\Dev Debug\ss2vr-work\backups\ss2vr-parachute-20260524-202812.zip.

nodes.label: Motion Controls Section
nodes.rationale: New [motion_controls] section in live ini, defaulted off. Requires motion_controls.enabled=true and F7 to start polling.

nodes.label: OpenXR Action Set
nodes.rationale: Binds left/right aim pose, trigger, squeeze, select, and menu clicks. Suggests bindings for khr/simple_controller and oculus/touch_controller.

nodes.label: UI Virtual Cursor
nodes.rationale: Uses a pragmatic mouse bridge: updates injected cursor pixel then holds ui_click_input while trigger/select is held over UI.

nodes.label: World Frob
nodes.rationale: world_frob_mode=call_handler queues requests from OpenXR/render thread to game-thread PlayerTurnTilt hook.

nodes.label: Keyboard Emulation
nodes.rationale: Maps Quest/Oculus Touch controls to normal keyboard/mouse input for testing before native action hooks.

nodes.label: Native Movement Action Bridge
nodes.rationale: Publishes left stick as ss2vr_move; ss2vr_move.nut drives in-game actions via Debug.Command (+walkfast, etc.).

nodes.label: SEH Safety Cleanup
nodes.rationale: OpenXR native-call helpers use POD-only SehCall* trampolines with __try/__except wrappers for safety.

nodes.label: Snap-Turn v2
nodes.rationale: Reintroduces snap turns through KEX mouse-accumulator/body path; uses authoritative display baseline.

nodes.label: Pitch Servo
nodes.rationale: Drives pitch via mouse-look correction based on HMD pitch vs KEX pitch to prevent delta integration drift.

nodes.label: Right-Hand Aim Prototype
nodes.rationale: Hooks FUN_14051ee80 and FUN_1404574c0 to map weapon_hand into KEX camera basis for launch/trace direction.

nodes.label: Weapon Viewmodel Pose Bridge
nodes.rationale: Publishes right-hand pose to ss2vr_aim via FUN_1408d2c20; consumed by Squirrel Weapon Handoff Probe.

nodes.label: Two-Hand Weapon Support
nodes.rationale: Phase 3.6 support handling; left grip engages when near support point in front of right controller.

nodes.label: Manual Reload Gesture
nodes.rationale: Phase 5.12.1 two-stage reload: pull down to unload, push up to reload_gun.

nodes.label: RenderView Override
nodes.rationale: Rewrites RenderView camera matrices in Map/Unmap path for head-tracked view and 6DOF translation.
